guarantees.claim: stL is driven to the corresponding recoded value (e.g. StIdleL for StIdle, …) when st matches a defined state; otherwise stL is driven to StErrorL via the default branch.

uncertain_points.claim: unique case combined with glitchy or multi-bit transitions on st could violate the one-hot assumption of unique, leading to synthesis-simulation mismatch or a spurious StErrorL before the intended state takes effect.
uncertain_points.cond: when st changes and temporarily matches multiple case items (e.g. due to different input arrival times).
uncertain_points.risk: Recoded state stL may briefly take StErrorL or an implementation-defined value, potentially propagating a false error to downstream logic.
